test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing North. G is to the immediate right of E. G is sitting to the extreme right of the row. A is sitting to the third place from the left of E. B is sitting to the immediate right of A. C is sitting to the right of B. D is sitting to the immediate left of A. Who is sitting to the extreme left of the row?
solution: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G** are sitting in a row facing North. 1. G is sitting to the extreme right of the row. 2. G is to the immediate right of E. 3. A is sitting to the third place from the left of E. 4. B is sitting to the immediate right of A.
